items.prompt: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי וּלְשׁוֹנִי תַּגִּיד צִדְקָתֶךָ
items.answer: Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God of my salvation, and my tongue shall declare thy righteousness.

items.prompt: כִּי תִדּוֹר נֶדֶר לַיהוָה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לְשַׁלְּמוֹ
items.answer: When thou vowest a vow to Yahweh, do not forget to pay it.

items.answer: His enemies were afraid to approach him.

items.prompt: וַיַּפֵּל יהוה תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־הָאָדָם וַיִּקַּח אַחַת מִצַּלְעֹתָיו וְהַצֵּלָע אֲשֶׁר לָקַח בָּנָה לְאִשָּׁה
items.answer: And Yahweh caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he took one of his ribs; and the rib which he had taken he built into a woman.

items.prompt: אָמַר הָאָדָם הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה עִמָּדִי הִוא נָתְנָה־לִּי מִן־הָעֵץ
items.answer: The man said, The woman whom thou gavest (to be) with me, she gave me of the tree.

items.prompt: אָמַר יהוה אֶל־אַבְרָם הִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּאָרֶץ לְאָרְכָּהּ וּלְרָחְבָּהּ כִּי לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָם עַל פָּנָיו
items.answer: Yahweh said to Abram, Walk through the land in the length of it and the breadth of it, for to thee will I give it; and Abram fell upon his face.

items.prompt: חָלַם יַעֲקֹב וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
items.answer: Jacob dreamed, and, behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven.
We have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the lands.

items.prompt: של נעליך מעל רגליך כי המקום אשר אתה עומד עליו אדמת־קדש הוא
items.answer: Put off thy sandals from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou art standing is holy ground.

items.answer: And the king said to him, Give me thy vineyard for money; and he said, I will not give thee my vineyard.
